quote.text: And when you ask your employee to do something, remember that she may not do as you wish. But giving her the power to upset you does no good for either of you.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Be gentle in guiding your children, understanding that they have their own innate paths; impose less and empower them to learn from their own choices.
    • Realize that expecting your will to be followed precisely can lead to frustration; focus instead on nurturing their growth and character, free from your own anxieties.
  • Leadership:
    • When leading others, remember that your role is to set the vision and provide guidance, not to control every detail of execution; trust in the abilities of those you lead.
    • Allow room for autonomy and accept that differing approaches may yield unexpected but valuable outcomes, keeping your peace by being detached from rigid expectations.
  • Product Management:
    • In managing products, clarity in communication is key, but even the best plans might be executed in unforeseen ways; adapt and learn with each iteration.
    • Separate your emotional investment from the end-result, fostering a culture of innovation that welcomes diverse solutions rather than being derailed by rigidity in expectations.
